The three remaining active 2010 Spain World Cup winners are Sergio Ramos, Raúl Albiol and Juan Mata. All are currently free agents without a club. Ramos (last at Monterrey) has been linked to a possible Getafe move. Albiol (last at Pisa) is exploring options and taking a coaching course. Mata (last at Melbourne Victory) has joined the club’s ownership group while considering his next playing step.
